parameters.scope: Capability prototype on three synthetic known controls only. No unknown page or unknown candidate is scored.
parameters.dictionary: Unchanged external Emerson corpus excluding essayII, greedy per-word GP encoding, split apostrophes, all8182 rune-word types. No LP text.
parameters.score: Frozen E016 external4gram, unchanged. Dictionary word patterns seed the search; they are not hard plaintext assertions.
parameters.initializations: Up to4 distinct cipher segments length4..14 with smallest nonempty dictionary equality-pattern bucket; ties decreasing length then first offset. Up to4 most frequent matching rune words per anchor, ties lexicographic. Complete bijection by cipher/English unigram ranks. Plus frequency-only start and7 perturbed starts with exactly8 random swaps each. Deduplicate maps, at most24 restarts.
parameters.optimization: Up to40 steepest-ascent sweeps per restart, exhaust all406 two-symbol key swaps each sweep, deterministic lexicographic ties. Stop a restart when improvement<=1e-12. No random acceptance, no exhaustive29! claim. No parameter tuning after results.
parameters.encryption: Random(3301035) creates one uniformly shuffled29-rune plaintext-to-cipher permutation per fixture in listed order. Source boundaries carried through substitution.
parameters.gate: All3 full plaintexts exactly recovered as top1 before any unknown-page escalation. Dictionary coverage recorded descriptively. Controls are previously seen texts, not blind historical validation.
parameters.null: Three independent uniform exact-count shuffles per synthetic cipher with segment endpoints fixed, seed3302035+100*fixture_index+replicate. Doublet count is NOT conditioned in these capability diagnostics. Rebuild pattern seeds and optimize identical budget each time; search RNG=3303035+100*fixture_index for both truth and its nulls. No discovery p-value. A future unknown-page scan needs separately specified stronger matched nulls.
parameters.selection: Report all controls, all null maxima, all restarts and exact recovery. No winner selection or inferential significance. Future unknown scan requires its own fixed full-optimizer null plan.
parameters.memory: One process; max1024 cipher runes,24 starts,406 key-neighbor rows,29^4 score table and8182 dictionary words. No candidate ensemble retained.
parameters.limits: Heuristic local optimization with finite initializations; may miss a correct substitution. Unknown spellings/dictionary gaps not evidence against substitution. Partial/near recovery does not pass the exact gate.

external_source.normalization: Explicit ae/oe ligature expansion; NFKD and combining-mark removal; ASCII words; QU->CW, remainingQ->C; greedyGP within words; no ngrams across paragraphs.
external_source.training_data: No Liber Primus plaintext or ciphertext, and no Self-Reliance text is used.
